decision.rationale: M391 r1b exact inputs, runner, 18-file output manifest and seal verify. Independent report parsing reproduces +0.6302 ns setup, +0.0179 ns hold, 100/100 reported paths MET and zero constraint violations. All 7144 untested checks partition exactly into constant_disabled=1872, no_paths=124, no_startpoint_clock=1716 and no_clock=3432. SDC-2 and PTE-003 are P2 evidence-quality issues rather than P0/P1 for this bounded prelayout point. Recovery/removal, SPEF/clock-tree timing, physical SRAM and power remain outside admission.

integrity.failed_r1_reason: RUN_FAILED_OR_INCOMPLETE exists with runner_exit_code=42; RUN_COMPLETE, runner hash, output manifest and output seal are absent.

SDC_2.finding: DC wrote SDC 2.1 while PrimeTime read_sdc announces 2.2. The expected 3 ns clock, 0.1 ns uncertainty, I/O delays, loads and reset false-path are present, and populated timing/coverage reports show they were applied. Normalize the SDC version before signoff-quality replay.

PTE_003.finding: PrimeTime reports disabled arcs due to constant propagation or loop breaking. Coverage explicitly attributes 1872 checks to constant_disabled and check_timing reports no loop issue. A dedicated report_disable_timing artifact was not sealed, so the warning is bounded but cannot be erased from later signoff evidence.

findings.title: SDC version mismatch is tolerated only for this bounded replay
findings.detail: Two SDC-2 warnings record SDC 2.1 versus the PrimeTime 2.2 reader. Core constraints are visibly active, but later replay should eliminate the mismatch.

findings.title: Disabled arcs lack a dedicated retained listing
findings.detail: PTE-003 is consistent with constant propagation and the exact reason ledger, while loop checking emits no issue. report_disable_timing was not included, so physical/signoff promotion is not admitted.

findings.title: Reset recovery and removal are entirely outside signoff
findings.detail: reset_n is the sole port without clock-relative input delay and is explicitly false-pathed. Recovery and removal each have 858/858 untested checks; no_startpoint_clock totals 1716 exactly.

findings.title: The timing point is prelayout only
findings.detail: No SPEF is present; clock is ideal, ZeroWireload is inherited, macro count is zero and descriptor/PWP SRAMs are not physical instances.

findings.title: Activity-backed power remains blocked
findings.detail: PT-STA does not create an activity contract. Without exact-workload SAIF and mapped annotation coverage, PTPX is NO-GO.

findings.title: M391 r1 is failed provenance
findings.detail: The first directory terminates with exit code 42 and has no success marker, runner receipt, output manifest or seal. It cannot be cited.
